speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have weakness and decreased sensation in your right arm. To help narrow down the cause, can you tell me when these symptoms started and if they are getting better or worse?

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male bodybuilder. The patient has been experiencing weakness in his right arm for a few weeks, which has progressively worsened to the point of dropping objects. He also reports a recent unexplained weight loss of 17 pounds and has a history of diabetes. The patient admits to chronic alcohol use, heavy smoking, and anabolic steroid use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of diabetes and anabolic steroid use, have you noticed any changes in your vision, difficulty speaking, or weakness in your legs? Also, to rule out nerve compression, can you tell me if the pain or numbness radiates from your neck?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness in the right arm. I also have Decreased sensation in the right arm, Dull aching and burning pain in the right arm, Significant weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your significant weight loss and risk factors, we need to rule out malignancy or severe neuropathy. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count. REQUEST TEST: HbA1c. Do you have any lumps, masses, or skin changes on your right arm or chest?
